name: Aneesha Fernando
description: Co-author of 2025 BioWhere New Zealand culturally enriched place-name research.
story: GIScience 2025 accepted abstracts, official conference programme lists Aneesha Fernando as an author of “The BioWhere Gazetteer: A Culturally Enriched Place Name Knowledge Base for New Zealand”.

The accepted GIScience 2025 abstract names Fernando as a co-author of the BioWhere Gazetteer: a proposed enriched knowledge base for Aotearoa New Zealand place names. The model describes combining LINZ gazetteer entries and volunteered geographic information from OpenStreetMap and GeoNames with Māori place-name context and multiple geometries. The accepted abstract documents a design proposal and shared research authorship; individual implementation tasks are not assigned.
